clue.text: Establishment response is to have Conservative as leader

indicators.text: is to have Conservative as leader
indicators.note: the letter standing for Conservative is told to go to the front of the word, so it shifts from its place inside

parts.note: a reaction is a response

explanation.surface: A Tory takes the lead in the Establishment's reply.
explanation.walkthrough: The C already sits inside REACTION; 'is to have Conservative as leader' moves it to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Creation, like establishment, is the act of founding or setting something up.

clue.text: Writer born in London, a city with style

parts.note: Chester is a cathedral city in Cheshire
ton means fashion or style, as in high society

explanation.surface: A biographical note on a stylish writer from the capital.
explanation.definitionFit: G K Chesterton, author of the Father Brown stories, was born in Kensington, London.

clue.text: Letter from abroad due when?

definitions.meaning: a letter of the Greek alphabet
the abbreviation for estimated time of arrival tells when someone is due

explanation.definitionFit: Eta is the seventh Greek letter, and the same letters abbreviate estimated time of arrival.

clue.text: Two rugby teams imbibing squash originally this?

definitions.text: Two rugby teams imbibing squash originally this?

indicators.note: drinking something in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a rugby union side has fifteen players, so two make thirty

indicators.note: the start of the word squash is taken

explanation.surface: Two rugby sides sip orange squash, presumably because they are parched.
explanation.walkthrough: Rugby union teams have fifteen players each. The whole clue also hints at the answer: players drinking squash must be parched.
explanation.definitionFit: Players taking in squash after a match are presumably dry and in need of a drink.

clue.text: Having obsession, tend to support particular part of rail network

indicators.note: in a down answer the supporting piece goes underneath, so it comes last

parts.note: one as in a single, particular one
a track is part of a railway system
to mind is to look after or tend

explanation.surface: Someone obsessed is keen to look after a stretch of the railway.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-track mind is a fixation on a single subject, an obsession.

clue.text: Game is mine after retreat by queen

indicators.note: a retreat goes backwards, so the word for mine is turned round

parts.note: a pit is a mine
a queen is a female cat

explanation.surface: A mining game in which a queen pulls back.
explanation.walkthrough: Queen here is a female cat, not royalty or a chess piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Tipcat is an old game in which a tapered piece of wood is struck with a stick.

clue.text: Coterie from ruling party

parts.note: the party in office is said to be in
a group of people is a party

explanation.surface: A clique drawn from the governing party.
explanation.definitionFit: An in-group is an exclusive set of insiders, a coterie.

clue.text: This is unlikely to be staged — cost alarmed cast

definitions.text: This is unlikely to be staged

indicators.note: to cast is to throw into a new form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A producer frets that the cost alarmed the actors of an unstageable play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cast' looks like the actors, but it is the anagram signal working on COST ALARMED.
explanation.definitionFit: A closet drama is a play written to be read rather than performed.

clue.text: Row following match? That's right

parts.note: a tie is a cup match

explanation.surface: A row breaks out after a game, and someone says that's correct.
explanation.definitionFit: A tier is a row, as of seats one above another.

clue.text: Old underground worker without answer for inspector

indicators.note: in the old sense of outside, so these pieces surround the letter

parts.note: ex means former
a miner works underground

explanation.surface: A former miner, with no answer, becomes an inspector.
explanation.definitionFit: An examiner is someone who inspects or tests, an inspector.

clue.text: Snub Italian man not using his head

indicators.note: the word loses its first letter, its head

parts.note: signore is the Italian for a gentleman or mister

explanation.surface: An Italian gentleman behaves thoughtlessly and gives offence.
explanation.definitionFit: To ignore someone deliberately is to snub them.

clue.text: Hit on drink that's full of flavour, and make unexpected fortune

parts.note: to strike is to hit
It is Italian vermouth, as in gin and It
rich food is full of flavour

explanation.surface: Discovering a flavourful drink makes someone wealthy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It' is short for Italian vermouth, a crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: To strike it rich is an idiom for suddenly coming into a fortune.

clue.text: Reverse a tutor suffered making valuable discovery

indicators.note: the letters undergo damage and come out jumbled

explanation.surface: A teacher's setback leads to a great find.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reverse' looks like an instruction to turn letters round, but it is part of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Treasure trove is buried valuables found by chance, a valuable discovery.

clue.text: Play this quiet passage in Lohengrin in new way

indicators.note: the word for quiet passes into the opera title
the letters are set out in a different order

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet

explanation.surface: Advice to play a hushed passage of Wagner's opera differently.
explanation.walkthrough: Lohengrin is a Wagner opera; SH goes inside it and the whole is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: The cor anglais, this instrument, is one you would play.

clue.text: When I close book, I won't reopen it

definitions.text: When I close book, I won't reopen it

parts.words: When I close book, I won't reopen it
parts.note: read literally, a reader finishing a book; really a phrase said to close a subject for good

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means the matter is finished and not to be discussed again.

clue.text: Girl shown round good school

indicators.note: the girl's name goes around the other letter

parts.note: Ruby is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl is given a tour of a fine school.
explanation.walkthrough: Rugby is an English public school.
explanation.definitionFit: Rugby School in Warwickshire is a famous English public school.

clue.text: Contributed funds? Done like a shot, of course

definitions.meaning: to add one's share of money to a collection

definitions.text: Done like a shot, of course
definitions.meaning: a golfer's short lofted stroke on a golf course that drops in the hole

explanation.definitionFit: To chip in is to contribute money, and in golf a ball chipped in is holed from off the green.

clue.text: French flag, rifle and ammo in revolution?

indicators.note: turned over, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Guns and bullets beneath the French standard during a revolution.
explanation.definitionFit: The oriflamme was the sacred red banner of the early French kings.

clue.text: A parliamentarian involved in a silly subject to ridicule

indicators.note: wrapped up within, so the pieces sit inside

parts.note: a loon is a silly person, a fool
MP is a member of parliament

explanation.surface: A politician is caught up with a fool and mocked.
explanation.definitionFit: To lampoon is to satirise, holding someone up to ridicule.

clue.text: Punish a Korean hiding hat from soldier

indicators.note: the words conceal the answer inside them

explanation.surface: A Korean is punished for hiding a soldier's hat.
explanation.definitionFit: A shako is a tall peaked military cap with a plume.

clue.text: Walks fast and pants

explanation.definitionFit: To stride is to walk with long steps, and strides is slang for trousers.

clue.text: Philanthropists confused him with an Austrian

indicators.note: mixed up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Kind-hearted people mistook him for an Austrian.
explanation.definitionFit: Humanitarians work to improve human welfare, as philanthropists do.

clue.text: Upsetting time once to make changes

indicators.note: turning upside down, which in a down answer reads it bottom to top

parts.note: tide is an old word for time, as in Yuletide

explanation.surface: Disrupting the old timetable to make alterations.
explanation.definitionFit: To edit text is to revise it, making changes.

clue.text: Short work shown on box about style of pop music

indicators.note: in an across answer one piece is placed after the other
turned around, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: box is a tree whose timber is a wood
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: A brief piece appears on television about pop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'box' looks like television, but it is the tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Doo-wop is a vocal harmony style of 1950s pop music.

clue.text: Wine retired old boy tucks into is hot stuff!

indicators.note: goes inside, so the reversed piece sits within the drink

parts.note: vino is informal for wine

indicators.note: drawn back, so the words are read backwards

parts.note: a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A retired old boy tucks into a fiery curry with wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retired' turns 'old boy' backwards to give DALO; 'Wine' looks like a separate drink but holds that piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A vindaloo is a very hot curry, hot stuff indeed.

clue.text: Solution for washing couch, say

indicators.note: signals that the word is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: to lie is to recline, as on a couch

explanation.surface: A cleaning fluid for a sofa, perhaps.
explanation.definitionFit: Lye is an alkaline solution used for washing and cleaning.

clue.text: Officer's no place for one in his flat?

indicators.note: signals that the officer has the place word removed

parts.note: a lieutenant is an officer
lieu means place, as in in lieu of

explanation.surface: An officer has nowhere to house a man in his flat.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenant is someone renting and living in a flat.

clue.text: Dubliner finally gets stuck into drink Irish have with mutton chops

indicators.note: goes inside, so the letter is placed within the drink

parts.note: Irish spirit is spelt whiskey

indicators.note: the last letter of Dubliner is taken

explanation.surface: A Dubliner downs whiskey with a plate of mutton chops.
explanation.walkthrough: Mutton chops are bushy side-whiskers, not meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Mutton chops are side-whiskers, so a face with them is whiskery.
